messages:
Liam (NovaShop): Hi team — after the 23:05 rollout our checkout-summary responses sometimes tack on an extra line like "Estimated shipping: $X" even when we don't ask for shipping. Seen in ~3% of calls since ~23:07 UTC and we also got two 502s in that window. Mobile renderer breaks because it assumes no pricing lines.

Priya (CS): sorry to hear that, Liam. Can you paste one or two raw examples (request body + full response) and the request_ids? Also which model/version are you pinned to?

Liam (NovaShop): Example below. Model pinned to rw-open-redwood-2.4.1.
Prompt: "Summarize cart items for mobile checkout view"
Response (trimmed): "2 items — subtotal $28.00\nEstimated shipping: $5.00"
request_ids: r-20250318-aa11bb22, r-20250318-aa11bb23

Devon (Eng): thanks. Do you attach any system messages, tool calls, or routing flags? Any rate limit responses or traffic spikes? The 502s might be transient but we'll check timestamps.

Liam (NovaShop): Plain chat call, we add a tiny system prompt on our route. Traffic steady, no burst. No tool calls.

Priya (CS): Please run a single debug call so we can capture the actual prompt stack. Use query params: ?debug=true&include_prompt=true. Example curl:

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions?debug=true&include_prompt=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-open-redwood-2.4.1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize cart items for mobile checkout view"}],"max_tokens":80}'
```

Priya (CS): paste the debug id you get back and we'll pull the internal stack; we only use it for triage.

deploy-bot: Deploy rw-open-redwood-2.4.1 -> prod completed at 2025-03-18T23:05:47Z by @release-ci

Liam (NovaShop): debug_id: dbg-20250318-99b2

Devon (Eng): good — Nina, can you jump in? This smells like a low-probability suffix insertion possibly introduced by the 2.4.1 rollout. I'll search logs around the timeframe:
- Kibana: status:502 AND path:"/v1/completions" AND model:"rw-open-redwood-2.4.1" AND @timestamp:[2025-03-18T22:50:00 TO 2025-03-18T23:30:00]
- scan outputs for terminal token sequence "Estimated shipping"

Nina (ML): tagging — if we can reproduce locally with the same system prompt we can diff token logits to identify where the shipping tokens gain probability. If it repros on 2.4.1 but not 2.3.x that's a strong model-regression signal. Please paste the system prompt text (redact PII).

Liam (NovaShop): System prompt (redacted): "You are a concise checkout summarizer. NEVER include pricing or shipping estimates unless the user explicitly requests them. Keep responses minimal."

Priya (CS): perfect, that helps. We'll open a ticket and attach dbg-20250318-99b2 and the request_ids. Devon: plan for triage?

Devon (Eng): Plan: 1) pull the recorded prompt stack from internal debug using dbg-20250318-99b2 2) replay the minimal request against rw-open-redwood-2.4.1 in isolation 3) if reproduced, replay against rw-open-redwood-2.3.9 canary to check delta 4) run token-level diff and content-detection to find origin. If 502s correlate we'll escalate to infra. I'll update here within a few hours.

Liam (NovaShop): Thanks — also note this only occurs on our route /v1/novashop/checkout-summary which injects the system prompt above. Hopefully that narrows the surface.

Priya (CS): Thanks Liam, we appreciate the quick repro info. We'll share the ticket link and ETA shortly. :thumbsup:

Liam (NovaShop): Appreciate it, team — standing by for updates.
